Introduction

This document lists the equipment 
inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated 
and tested 
by eng. Abdallah El-Sayed Mohamed, accepted by eng. Al Sayed Atia Abdel-Maqsoud 
general director, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality 
control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Nagar, 
approved by eng Awad Fathy; head sector of Talkha PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant, Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman, EDEPC admin. and financial 
 inspection, quality control General Director and supervisor of inspection and 
 quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category.

Wear 
 your safety helmet, shoes and safety belt when cleaning suspension insulators.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

 done.

Clean the feed-throughs,

Check the tightness of the 
connections.

Check the protection 
device for the following functions: oil level, internal pressure, 
temperature

Touch up the paintwork if 
necessary.

Check that the porcelain 
parts and the tank show no sign of damage.

Check up the quality of 
the dielectric oil every 10 years.

Introduction
This document lists the equipment 
inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated

The first draft initiated

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category.
Wear 
 your safety helmet, shoes and safety belt when cleaning suspension insulators.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Ensure that the transformer was isolated, and proper earthing on both sides is 
 done.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multimeter (AVO)
Complete tool kit of screw drivers and common keys
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the feed-throughs,
Check the tightness of the 
connections.
Check the protection 
device for the following functions: oil level, internal pressure, 
temperature
Touch up the paintwork if 
necessary.
Check that the porcelain 
parts and the tank show no sign of damage.
Check up the quality of 
the dielectric oil every 10 years.
